observations.command:
set -eu
echo '@@ BOOT'; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME'; date -u +%s; cat /proc/uptime
echo '@@ CORE'; pidof avocd; pidof deviced
O=/tmp/researcher-observed-quiescent-pm-onset-20261026/owner-power-on-20261026a
SD=/tmp/researcher-observed-quiescent-pm-onset-stage-20261026/owner-power-on-20261026a
T=/sys/kernel/debug/tracing/instances/researcher-quiescent-pm-onset-owner-power-on-20261026a
echo '@@ OWNED_FILES'
for f in "$O"/* "$SD"/*; do if test -f "$f" && test ! -L "$f"; then stat -c '%n %s %u %a' "$f"; case "$f" in *.pid) cat "$f";; esac; fi; done
echo '@@ COLLECTOR_PROC'
if test -r /proc/28815/stat; then cat /proc/28815/stat; cat /proc/28815/wchan; cat /proc/28815/syscall; fi
echo '@@ COLLECTOR_GROUP'
for f in /proc/[0-9]*/stat; do row=; { IFS= read -r row <"$f"; } 2>/dev/null || continue; rest=${row##*) }; set -- $rest; if test "${3:-}" = 28815; then echo "$row"; fi; done
echo '@@ TRACE_STATE'
if test -d "$T"; then cat "$T/tracing_on" "$T/current_tracer"; grep 'CAPTURE_.*utc=' "$T/trace"; else echo PRIVATE_INSTANCE_ABSENT; fi
echo '@@ GLOBAL'; cat /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/tracing_on /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/current_tracer
echo '@@ COMPLETE'
